title: The Map Got a Job
summary:
Why institutions trade truth for a payroll. Once a map pays, the test becomes optional and the syllable stays mandatory. Law, science, and the news run the same plate. Goodhart's law: when the measure becomes the target, it stops measuring. The robes and the stone tablets are furniture. Scrutiny is what they drop the second the poster prints. Truth was a sentence that had not broken yet under looking that is still happening. Not a rock in the yard. Not a personal story you don't have to check.

Two-voice cut of Randall Rant, The Map Got a Job. Not the Codex. The looking is the job.
